body:
#### PR description:

- The consumes API now permits specify to which edm::Transition the request will be made
- Internal prefetching APIs have been updated
- Modules in FWCore now specify the information

#### PR validation:

Code compiles, framework unit tests pass.

resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2503
title: Specify in consumes call to which transition the data will be requested.
